town_description: Curchorem (Curchorem-Cacora) is a municipal town in Quepem taluka, South Goa, on the Zuari river hinterland about 35 km south-east of Margao. Once a mining centre, it is a market town for surrounding villages, near the Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary and a cluster of local Hindu and Catholic shrines.
